patch.summary: Set multiple custom field values on an organisation
patch.description: Set one or more custom field values in a single request (at most 50 per request). Unknown field keys are created automatically, with their type inferred from the value — so an integration does not have to pre-create fields. Values are validated against each field's type, and for select/status/multi-select fields against the field's defined options; an unusable value, an off-list option, or a bad key returns a 422 naming the offending key. Validation covers the whole payload before anything is written, so a rejected key never leaves earlier keys half-applied. Every value must be non-empty: sending an empty array does not clear a multi-select — use the DELETE custom-fields/{key} endpoint to remove a value.

parameters.description: The UUID of the workspace

parameters.name: organisationUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the organisation

422.description: A field key or value was invalid

get.summary: Overview of the sessions in a date range
get.description: Lists sessions within a date range. A date range is required: provide either `date` or `date_from` (optionally with `date_to`), otherwise the request fails with a 400.

parameters.name: workspaceUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the workspace

parameters.name: segmentUuid
parameters.description: Only include sessions matching this segment UUID

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The specific date to filter sessions. Cannot be used together with date_from/date_to. Either `date` or `date_from` must be provided.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start date for filtering sessions (inclusive). Required unless `date` is provided.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: End date for filtering sessions (inclusive). Defaults to the end of today when omitted.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Filter sessions where the visited URL contains the given string.

parameters.name: referrer
parameters.description: Filter sessions where the referrer contains the given string.

parameters.name: visitor_uuid
parameters.description: Only include sessions of this visitor (client) ID — the `visitor_uuid` returned on every session, and the value the tracker sends as `anonymous_id`. Lets a client-side ID minted at conversion time be resolved back to the sessions, and therefore the organisation, it belongs to.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number for pagination. page × size may not exceed 25,000 rows; narrow the listing with date_from and date_to instead of paging deeper.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of sessions per page (1-1000).

200.description: List of sessions. When more than `organisation_limit` organisations match the date range, the response is truncated to the most-recently-active organisations and `truncated` is set to true. The caller can use the per-organisation sessions endpoint to backfill any orgs beyond the cap.

truncated.description: True when the organisation set was capped to `organisation_limit`.

total_organisations.description: Total number of organisations matching the filter, before any cap.

organisation_limit.description: Maximum number of organisations included in a single response.

400.description: Invalid parameters, e.g. no date range provided
